laws.rule: Islas Marietas National Park opens Tuesday to Sunday, 8 am to 6 pm; Playa del Amor (Hidden Beach) opens Wednesday to Sunday, 8 am to 5 pm. Visits are only with boats and guides authorised by CONANP, the federal protected-areas agency.
laws.heading: Comisión Nacional de Áreas Naturales Protegidas

laws.rule: Islas Marietas National Park: CONANP's visitor rules say follow guides and rangers; a life jacket is compulsory in the water; no alcohol; no rubbish; don't take or introduce animals; no single-use plastics; use environment-friendly sunscreen at least 30 minutes before entering the water; and no footwear in water or beach activities.

Islas Marias Biosphere Reserve: CONANP's visitor rules say don't take plants, animals, shells or coral; don't feed or interact with wildlife; no pets other than assistance or medical animals; no campfires; complete the island biosecurity protocol; don't litter, including cigarette butts; and follow guides and Navy personnel.

layers.authority: CONANP (Comision Nacional de Areas Naturales Protegidas), Parque Nacional Islas Marietas
layers.process: Entry fee of MXN 125 per person per day (about A$9.45; A$1 = about MXN 13.23 (RBA 30 October 2026, A$1 = USD 0.7040; Banco de Mexico FIX, USD 1 = MXN 18.7962)). Exempt: older adults, pensioners and retirees, people with disability and children under 12 (credential shown on entry). 75% off for students and teachers with a credential; 50% off for Mexican nationals and foreign residents who show an official document. Open Tuesday to Sunday 8:00 to 18:00; Playa del Amor Wednesday to Sunday 8:00 to 17:00. The page doesn't state a visitor cap or permit.

layers.authority: CONANP (Comision Nacional de Areas Naturales Protegidas), Reserva de la Biosfera Islas Marias
layers.process: Entry fee of MXN 750 per person per day (about A$56.69; A$1 = about MXN 13.23 (RBA 30 October 2026, A$1 = USD 0.7040; Banco de Mexico FIX, USD 1 = MXN 18.7962)). Exempt: older adults, pensioners and retirees, people with disability and children under 12 (credential shown on entry). 75% off for students and teachers with a credential; 50% off for Mexican nationals and foreign residents who show an official document. Open Friday to Sunday: arrival at Maria Madre island on Friday about 17:00 and departure Sunday about 11:00. Access is by Secretaria de Marina ship or aircraft from Mazatlan (Sinaloa) or San Blas (Nayarit). Visitors complete an island biosecurity protocol before entering.
